behavior: coordinated save generation validation and integrity-backed recovery
summary: Items can stamp and validate an explicit coordinated generation across Character, Economy, Quests, Events, NPC, World, and Items state. Recovery accepts only a structurally valid integrity-protected item generation matching the authoritative external generation snapshot.
safe_fallback: Reject missing or mismatched generations without mutating persisted state.
runtime_impact: Prevents accepting mixed-generation item and external ownership saves after restart or crash.
character_save_impact: Read-only validation of supplied Character generation.
world_state_impact: Items save is stamped and integrity-backed.
